predecessors.name: Kingdom of Afghanistan
predecessors.text: the whole country: the coup 'overthrew the Kingdom of Afghanistan and established the Republic of Afghanistan in its place'

successors.name: Afghanistan
successors.text: the whole country: the Democratic Republic of Afghanistan, established 30 April 1978 under Nur Muhammad Taraki after the Saur Revolution of 27-28 April

ledger.x: 17 July 1973: Daoud Khan overthrows the king and proclaims the Republic of Afghanistan.
27-28 April 1978: the Saur Revolution ends the republic.

wars.name: 1975 Panjshir Valley uprising
wars.outcome: A failed rebellion backed by Iran and Pakistan against Daoud's government (the page: 'a failed Iranian-Pakistani backed rebellion sought to oust the government'); no land changed hands.

wars.name: Saur Revolution
wars.outcome: Army units loyal to the party took Kabul in 24 hours on 27-28 April 1978; Daoud and most of his family were executed; no frontier moved.

certainty.note: The Durand Line was demarcated in 1894-1896 and Afghanistan did not recognise it; nothing on this page changes it.
